rationale: The previous telemetry indicated that the robot had stability issues, with 5 line loss events and an rms error of 0.2. To address this, I have integrated a controller that complements the new geometry with a wider body and wheel track. The controller parameters are set to enhance stability and responsiveness, with a base speed of 0.1, kp of 0.5, ki of 0.1, kd of 0.05, and sensor weights adjusted to [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. This should improve performance in the next race.
